listing.title: Ultimate Gorilla Expedition
listing.tagline: One gorilla, six games, and a base camp that goes wrong immediately.
listing.description: Launch a solo expedition from Gorilla Tag's world. A truck rolls into camp, supplies rain from above, cookies start multiplying, and an unpaid bill appears before your journey has even begun. Complete suspicious tasks and explore the crossover — with each companion's real installed content required, not copied into the mod. This listing remains a draft until the actual host integration and every required game-content adapter are built and tested.
